facts.fact: The law defines an Autorité de Protection and gives it functions (declarations and authorisations, transfer approval, investigation, guidelines) but has processing declarations go to the competent authority 'designated by regulation' (Art. 5); it names no constituted body or appointed members (document published 2016-07).
